CLOUD ROOT-CAUSE seat (dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md) for a recurring defect class of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (round 2 of PR #2606). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and .claude/rules/defect-root-cause.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own at the code tip `git fetch origin handoff/r10-rca-install-ratelimit` (0a8c4523a), merging origin/main in (now cd4aaed44, v7.0.3).
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-install-ratelimit, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-install-ratelimit <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-install-ratelimit. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 2 of PR #2606 (R10-RCA-INSTALL-RATELIMIT; PR head 83d21ff832455462268f1d9ce9d75c17a1209d07). Round 1 is BLOCKED claim-refuted: read `git fetch origin review/2606 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` (3f3e5bda1). Governance run 39745228063 completed a full record walk after two earlier full walks in the same 4 minutes (about 3,000 calls), which refutes the 1,000/hr bucket. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Spare the GitHub API: the reviewer's ev/ already holds the job logs.
Do exactly what the Block asks, and nothing else:
1. Restate the bucket size as unmeasured, citing run 39745228063 against 1,000. Withdraw or recompute 83 % and 3.2-4.6x. If you state a bound, it must be a lower bound the logs support (at least about 3,030 served from 08:03:46Z), labelled as such.
2. Rank the record job as the heaviest consumer on what survives: hundreds of calls per main push against tens per head, plus the 08:38 degradation (run 39749268769).
3. Section 4: M0 comes first, and the M3 call waits for M0's measured limit. Drop the "3 x 370 = 1,110 > 1,000" argument. Note the reviewer's M1/M2 interaction (about 5 runs, 1,850 calls on the 08Z replay) as for the countermeasure group to measure.
4. Correct the burst table: add 04c1dd779 (09:42Z) and b787c7d45 (06:35Z), and fix the 09Z row's count.
5. The harness findings (TOTAL 0 on a non-github origin; partial abort counted) are carried to R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET by the orchestrator. Cite them with `Carry: R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET` and do not fix them here. R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET is not on main's roster yet: it is on handoff/audit-r10-roster and lands in roster PR 12, so carry_audit run against `--roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster` must pass.
6. Re-take every figure, and rewrite the whole body.
Time box 45 min. Return on handoff/r10-rca-install-ratelimit plus body_push.sh r10-rca-install-ratelimit.
